claims.statement: Ashoka visited Lumbini and erected an inscribed pillar there. UNESCO dates the pillar to 249 BCE. This is a dated connection between a ruler and a place, rather than a general assumption that he visited every site associated with his dynasty.
Ashoka’s visit to Lumbini: 249 BCE to 249 BCE. Year follows UNESCO. The map uses the property reference, not a reconstructed route.
Lumbini property reference for the recorded visit
